methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 real framing nailers spanning cordless-battery, pneumatic, and cordless-gas (fuel-cell) drive systems from DeWalt, Metabo HPT, Milwaukee, Paslode, Bostitch, Ryobi, Makita, NuMax, Freeman, and Senco. Independently re-verified 2026-08-16 against manufacturer product pages (makitatools.com, ryobitools.com, metabo-hpt.com, milwaukeetool.com, dewalt.com, paslode.com, senco.com, freemantools.com) and reputable dealer/spec sources (Woodcraft, Burns Tools, Coastal Tool, Great Lakes Power Tools, ToolGuyd, Pro Tool Reviews). All 12 products confirmed to exist; none removed. Two originally-requested entries (Ryobi P330 = 15ga angled finish nailer; Makita XNB02 = 16ga finish nailer) had already been correctly swapped for each brand's actual cordless framing nailer (Ryobi PBL345B, Makita XNB03Z), and both replacements were verified on the manufacturers' own pages. Three fact-check corrections applied this pass: DCN692 releaseDate 2014-01 -> null (unverifiable); DWF83PL nail_length_range_in 2-3.25 -> 2-3.5 in (contradicted the model's 3-1/2 in. rating); Milwaukee 2745-20 magazine_capacity 51 -> null (claimed dealer corroboration does not actually state a count). A few street prices (Metabo NR90AES1 $219 at Menards/McCoy's, DeWalt DWF83PL ~$269, Makita XNB03Z $399) could not be re-fetched because those retailers bot-block automated requests, but each is consistent with the model's known market price and its manufacturer/dealer identity was confirmed. nail_length_range_in and weight_lb carry units in the string/number as noted; collation_angle_deg and magazine_capacity are unitless numbers; depth_adjustment and tool_free_jam_clear are booleans meaning 'yes, without a separate tool,' left null when no source stated it. accessedAt 2026-08-16.

products.name: DeWalt DCN692 20V MAX XR Cordless Framing Nailer
products.priceNote: MSRP, bare tool (DCN692B); 1-battery kit (DCN692M1) lists around $500
products.provenance: Verified nail length (2-3.5in, nails collated 30-34 deg), up-to-55-nail magazine, 7.80lb weight, bump/sequential modes and jam-clearing lever via ToolGuyd's spec breakdown, cross-checked against Pro Tool Reviews' hands-on review. Bare-tool MSRP of $400 (kit DCN692M1 ~$500) corroborated on ToolGuyd. FACT-CHECK: releaseDate changed 2014-01 -> null; no consulted source confirms a January 2014 launch (the line dates to roughly 2015), so the specific date is left null rather than asserted.

products.name: Metabo HPT NR90AES1 21° Pneumatic Framing Nailer
products.priceNote: Typical current retail price (Menards, McCoy's); Metabo HPT does not publish a direct MSRP for this pneumatic model
products.provenance: 64-nail magazine (.131in dia), 7.5lb weight, 2-3.5in nail range, 21 deg plastic collation, tool-less depth adjustment and open-nose jam clearing all verified on Metabo HPT's official product page (model listed as NR90AE(S1)). $219 is the model's typical street price (Menards/McCoy's; those retailers bot-block automated fetches so the exact listing was not re-read, but the price is consistent and no manufacturer MSRP exists). Release date not published (successor to the Hitachi-branded NR90AE after the 2018 Metabo HPT rebrand), left null.

products.name: Milwaukee M18 FUEL 30° Framing Nailer (2745-20)
products.provenance: Sequential/contact firing modes, tool-free depth adjustment, 30-34 deg collation and 2-3.5in nail range confirmed on Milwaukee's official product page. Weight (9.4lb) and $449 bare-tool price corroborated via the Great Lakes Power Tools dealer listing. FACT-CHECK: magazine_capacity changed 51 -> null; the cited dealer listing does not actually state a magazine count and no other consulted source confirmed 51, so a null is used rather than an unverified number. Jam-clearing mechanism and release year not stated on any source, left null.

products.name: Paslode Cordless XP Framing Nailer (CF325XP, 905600)
products.priceNote: Discontinued; replaced by the Cordless XPro (906800). No current manufacturer price exists — used/resale listings range roughly $150-335.
products.provenance: Confirmed on Paslode's official site that CF325XP (905600) is marked DISCONTINUED, 'No retailers available,' superseded by the Cordless XPro. Specs verified on that page: 7.2lb, 2-3.25in (2"-3-1/4") nails, 30 deg paper-tape collation, fuel-cell + 7V Li-ion power, tool-free depth adjustment; jam clearing needs a hex key (not tool-free). Magazine capacity is quoted by Paslode as '1 strip' not a numeric count, so left null. releaseDate 2015 is consistent with the operating-manual revision (9/15). priceUsd null — production ended, no current MSRP.

products.name: Bostitch F21PL 21° Pneumatic Framing/Metal-Connector Nailer
products.priceNote: Street price, multiple dealers ($269-$310); Stanley Black & Decker does not publish a direct consumer MSRP
products.provenance: Verified on the Burns Tools dealer spec sheet: 60-nail magazine, 8.1lb, 2-3.5in nails, 21 deg plastic collation, sequential with contact trigger included, $269 price; framing/metal-connector round-head design. Product identity corroborated at Lowe's. Exact release year not published (long-running catalog item), left null.

products.name: DeWalt DWF83PL 21° Pneumatic Framing Nailer
products.priceNote: Street price ~$264-273 across dealers; one retailer (ToolUp) lists MSRP $386.69
products.provenance: 21 deg plastic collation and selectable bump/sequential actuation confirmed on DeWalt's official product page. 64-nail magazine and 8lb weight per the McCoy's building-supply dealer spec sheet. FACT-CHECK: nail_length_range_in changed 2-3.25 -> 2-3.5 in; the DWF83PL is DeWalt's 3-1/2 in. 21 deg framing nailer (retailer titles list it as '3-1/2 in. x 21-Degree'), so a 3-1/4 in. max contradicts the model's rating. Street price ~$269. Jam-clearing mechanism and release year not stated on the sources consulted, left null.

products.name: Ryobi ONE+ HP 18V Brushless AirStrike 21° Framing Nailer (PBL345B)
products.priceNote: MSRP, tool only (PBL345B); kit with 4.0Ah battery/charger (PBL345K) sold separately
products.provenance: Corrected roster entry (unchanged this pass, re-verified): the originally requested Ryobi P330 is a 15-gauge angled finish nailer, not a framing nailer. Ryobi's actual cordless framing nailer, the ONE+ HP 18V AirStrike 21 deg PBL345B, was verified on Ryobi's official product page — $329 tool-only, drives full round head nails 'up to 3-1/2 in.' Ryobi gives no minimum nail length, no published magazine capacity, weight, or jam-clearing detail, so those are left null.

Jam-clearing mechanism and release date not stated, left null.
